name: What should I ask a pool renovation contractor before hiring?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before hiring a pool renovation company in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before hiring a pool renovation company in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring, homeowners should focus on scope clarity and contractor reliability. Ask what type of pool projects they complete most often, how they handle permits and inspections, who manages the crew, and whether they have experience with the specific finish or design you want. It is also smart to ask for a sample schedule, payment breakdown, warranty details, and references from similar Los Angeles projects. Hidden repairs are a major issue in pool renovation, so the contractor should explain how unexpected shell damage, plumbing leaks, or equipment problems will be handled. A strong contractor will not avoid details. They will walk through materials, sequencing, and possible change-order scenarios before work begins. The best hire is not simply the lowest bid; it is the team that can communicate clearly, set realistic expectations, and deliver a finished pool that matches the home’s style and neighborhood standard.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about license status, insurance, similar projects, permit handling, timeline, material options, payment schedule, warranty, and how hidden repairs are priced. A good contractor should explain the full scope clearly and identify what is included, excluded, and optional.
